g.text: Portability: preserve the contract, replace the provider
OV5 · nxrs design direction · not a claim of a qualified new RTOS or browser backend
A provider must preserve behavior, not just types. An OS/backend change also needs a separately qualified execution environment.
BLUE solid = API call | TEAL solid = data / ownership | ORANGE dashed = wake / schedule | GREY dotted = build / configuration

text.tspan: not supplied by a sensor API
POSIX is not a browser port
